curation_protocol: Built from primary-source downloads retrieved on 2026-09-10. Every source file URL, UTC retrieval time, server Date/Last-Modified headers, byte size and SHA-256 are recorded in dataset_downloads_2026-09-10/download_provenance.json. This manifest REPLACES config/dataset_manifest.interim.json, which declared itself INTERIM and NOT FOR SUBMISSION because its sources were recovered from legacy split CSVs rather than downloaded. CONFLICT POLICY: 1,188 sequences appeared in both a curated AMP database and a negative source. Experimental curation in DRAMP/APD6/dbAMP takes precedence over algorithmic negative sampling (AMPBenchmark) and over absence of AMP keywords in SwissProt; these sequences are retained as positives and removed from the negative sources. 49 of the 1,188 (4.1%) are 8 aa or shorter, where chance sequence collision is possible; this is declared rather than silently resolved. KNOWN GAP: CAMP R4 returned HTTP 503 on 2026-09-10 from every host tried and is absent from this build. MIXED-LABEL CURATION: MMseqs2 clustering of the exact-deduplicated pool produced 133 clusters containing both AMP and non-AMP labels (1,912 sequences). Following the policy already applied to the earlier build, every sequence in those clusters was dropped and none was relabelled.

sources.prefilter_provenance: Official DRAMP 3.0 general_amps.fasta downloaded 2026-09-10 from the URL recorded in dataset_downloads_2026-09-10/download_provenance.json; stored byte-identical to the server response with no local filtering. Verified against the legacy archive copy: all 11,687 legacy record identifiers are present in this release and 1,097 new records were added, i.e. the legacy file is a strict earlier snapshot of the same database. CURATION 2026-09-10: all sequences belonging to the 133 homology clusters that mixed AMP and non-AMP labels were REMOVED (551 sequences from this source). No sequence was relabelled. The dominant mixed families were cyclotides (cyclic cystine-knot plant peptides, curated as AMPs in one source and sampled as negatives in another) and small highly cationic ribosomal proteins L34/L36. This is direct evidence that the negative class is contaminated with antimicrobial peptide homologues.
